select sum(case when "done_at" is null and ("snoozed_until" is null or "snoozed_until" <= ?) then 1 else 0 end), sum(case when "done_at" is null and "snoozed_until" > ? then 1 else 0 end), sum(case when "done_at" is not null then 1 else 0 end) from "notifications" where ("notifications"."org_id" = ? and "notifications"."user_id" = ?)

select "type", count(*) from "notifications" where (("notifications"."org_id" = ? and "notifications"."user_id" = ?) and "notifications"."read_at" is null and ("notifications"."done_at" is null and ("notifications"."snoozed_until" is null or "notifications"."snoozed_until" <= ?))) group by "notifications"."type"

select "id", "org_id", "domain_id", "local_part", "address", "display_name", "quota_mb", "used_bytes", "status", "kind", "reply_to", "created_at" from "mailboxes" where ("mailboxes"."org_id" = ? and "mailboxes"."kind" = ?) order by "mailboxes"."address" asc
